content.thinking: The UBSan runtime error is in MY HARNESS code (harness.c:24: `hi &= (L == 64) ? ~0ULL : (~0ULL << (64 - L));` — when L=0, `~0ULL << 64` is UB). That's a harness bug, not a core.c bug. Let me fix the harness's mask computation and rerun.

arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
p='/app/tmp/asan/harness.c'
s=open(p).read()
old = """            if (L <= 64) hi &= (L == 64) ? ~0ULL : (~0ULL << (64 - L));
            if (L >= 64) lo = (L == 64) ? 0 : (lo & (~0ULL << (128 - L)));
            else lo = 0;"""
new = """            if (L == 0) { hi = 0; lo = 0; }
            else if (L <= 64) { hi &= (L == 64) ? ~0ULL : (~0ULL << (64 - L)); lo = 0; }
            else { lo &= ~0ULL << (128 - L); }"""
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
s = s.replace("            if (L == 0) { hi = 0; lo = 0; }\n            else if", "            else if")  # avoid dup
s = s.replace("            else { lo &= ~0ULL << (128 - L); }\n            if (L == 0) { hi = 0; lo = 0; }", "            else { lo &= ~0ULL << (128 - L); }")
open(p,'w').write(s)
print(open(p).read()[380:900])
EOF
gcc -O1 -g -fsanitize=undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -o /app/tmp/asan/harness_ub /app/tmp/asan/harness.c /app/submit/core.c -Wl,--start-group -lubsan -ldl -lpthread -lrt -lm -Wl,--end-group 2>&1 | tail -2; time /app/tmp/asan/harness_ub; echo "rc=$?"
